Winter Operations

Open daily from 9am to 4pm

Good Morning Riders!

Fresh snow is back after a long dry stretch, giving the mountain a much-needed refresh. The base sits at 39”, with light snow falling through late morning and early afternoon to keep surfaces soft and turning nicely.

Mostly cloudy with snow likely between 8am–2pm. Temps hover near 33–37°, light west-northwest winds, and a 70% chance of precipitation with up to an inch of new snow possible. A more active pattern continues into the week, so stay tuned.

Groomers are smooth, natural snow is skiing better by the hour, and today’s new flakes are a welcome reset across the hill.

New snow, plenty of terrain, and great winter vibes. Drive safe, dress warm, and we’ll see you on the slopes!

Last Updated Feb 09, 9:32 AM MT

Last Updated: Feb 09, 4:19 AM MT

Parking inventory is updated on weekends and holidays during the winter only. During the summer period, parking is abundant and is not expected to reach capacity.

Access Gates Safety Information Toggle accordion

All guests must use access gates regardless of website status. Website information is intended to inform the guest of terrain status, but it is the guest’s responsibility to confirm the area is open by entering through an access gate.  Signage on the mountain supersedes website information. Failure to use access gates may result in loss of pass privileges.
